note: Durations are planning estimates. Citations are statutory or regulatory. Each duration carries a basis marker: statutory_clock, agency_published, or stated_assumption.

phases.name: Exploration
phases.note: Pre-drilling geophysical work and resource confirmation. Geothermal does not always include a discovery phase.

phases.name: Drilling operations
phases.note: Operations plan, drilling permits, downhole review, well completion.

phases.name: Utilization
phases.note: Power plant construction, interconnection, lifecycle monitoring.

categorical_exclusions.name: Geophysical exploration Notice of Intent
categorical_exclusions.covers: Approval of Notices of Intent to conduct geophysical exploration of oil, gas, or geothermal
categorical_exclusions.source: DOI NEPA Appendix 2; CEQ CE Explorer v2.0.0 (2025-08-07)

gate_conditions.text: No temporary or new road construction proposed

categorical_exclusions.name: Operations plan and Geothermal Drilling Permits, resource confirmation
categorical_exclusions.covers: Approval of an operations plan and associated Geothermal Drilling Permits for a geothermal resource confirmation project
categorical_exclusions.source: DOI NEPA Appendix 2; CEQ CE Explorer v2.0.0 (2025-08-07)

gate_conditions.text: Does not exceed 20 acres of total surface disturbance, contiguous or noncontiguous
Requires reclamation of all surface disturbances when their intended purpose has been fulfilled
Requires reclamation of temporary routes when purpose fulfilled, unless BLM designates the route as part of its transportation system
Does not make a temporary route available for public use unless specifically intended to accommodate public use
Requires temporary routes constructed to allow reclamation of vegetative cover within 10 years after approved reclamation commences
Includes design elements to protect resources and resource uses consistent with the applicable Resource Management Plan, laws, regulations, and lease terms
gate_conditions.screening_source: BLM land use plans in ROI

extraordinary_circumstances.note: Applicability is determined by the Responsible Official. If any circumstance is present, the categorical exclusion does not apply and the action routes to an environmental assessment.

criteria.text: Significant impacts on public health or safety

Significant impacts on historic or cultural resources; park, recreation or refuge lands; wilderness areas; wild or scenic rivers; national natural landmarks; sole or principal drinking water aquifers; prime farmlands; wetlands; floodplains; national monuments; migratory birds; and other ecologically significant or critical areas
Highly uncertain and potentially significant environmental effects, or unique or unknown environmental risks
Establishes a precedent for future action or a decision in principle about future actions with potentially significant environmental effects
Direct relationship to other actions that implicate potentially significant environmental effects
Significant impacts on properties listed, or eligible for listing, on the National Register of Historic Places
Significant impacts on species listed or proposed to be listed, or on designated Critical Habitat
Significantly limits access to and ceremonial use of Indian sacred sites, or adversely affects the physical integrity of such sites
criteria.note: Requires consultation. Not determinable from spatial screening.

criteria.text: Contributes to potentially significant effects from noxious weeds or non-native invasive species

reviews.name: Biological assessment and survey seasons
reviews.note: Survey windows are seasonal. Duration reflects field season constraints, not a review clock.

reviews.name: ESA Section 7 formal consultation
reviews.note: The 135-day figure is the statutory clock. Tolling and biological assessment revision routinely extend it.

reviews.name: NHPA Section 106 tribal consultation
reviews.note: Runs on its own clock with its own predecessors. Distinct from SHPO review. Tribal Historic Preservation Officers are frequently responsible for very large areas with limited staff.

reviews.name: Wilderness Study Area and NLCS unit review
reviews.note: Non-impairment standards apply within WSAs. Proximity bears on visual resource management, route access, and analysis scope. Designation status must be current: several Nevada WSAs were reclassified by Pub. L. 117-263.

reviews.name: Mineral and geothermal leasing withdrawal check
reviews.note: Some designations withdraw public land from disposition under all laws relating to mineral and geothermal leasing, subject to valid existing rights. A withdrawal is dispositive, not a delay. No buffer zone applies unless the designating statute creates one.

reviews.name: NEPA decision document, FONSI or ROD
Sundry Notice
reviews.note: Required for minor operational changes, temperature or pressure surveys, flow tests, and routine maintenance. Approval must precede the change.

reviews.name: Nevada Geothermal Project Area Permit
reviews.note: Alternative to individual Permits to Drill where more than one well is proposed at a project location. Requires a plat, a complete drilling program, and equipment locations.

reviews.name: Nevada Geothermal Well Completion Report
reviews.note: Due within 60 days after completion or cessation of drilling. A reporting obligation, not a gate.

reviews.name: UIC Class V injection well permit
Right-of-way grant, roads, pipelines, transmission
reviews.note: Real geothermal Environmental Assessments cover pipelines, electricity transmission, and surface transportation alongside production. A development is a set of co-located actions, not a single well.

reviews.name: Power plant siting and utilization authorization
reviews.note: Utilization is a distinct phase. A categorical exclusion for resource confirmation is unavailable once utilization is proposed.

known_gaps: Vegetation and fuels management, and waste management, appear in real geothermal Environmental Assessments and are not modelled here.
Extraordinary circumstances (a), (c), (d), (e), and (i) are judgment determinations by the Responsible Official and cannot be screened.
Criterion (h), Indian sacred sites, requires consultation and is not determinable from spatial screening.
Local and county permits are not modelled. COMPASS geothermal ordinance data is in FY26 scope and not yet published.
Durations marked stated_assumption have no published basis and should be replaced with agency figures where they exist.
